title: ThumbDial node
description: A node in a ThumbDial hierarchy. This file is the canonical, machine-readable statement of the node contract that README documents in prose. lib/validate.js interprets it (plus semantic rules JSON Schema cannot express) — see that file's header for the supported keyword subset.

not.description: A node expands EITHER by authored children or by an ordinal count, never both.

label.description: What the wedge and hub call this node. Required on every node.

short.description: Abbreviation used when the wedge is too small for `label` (e.g. 'Jn' for 'John'). Should not be longer than `label`.

detail.description: Secondary line shown in the hub while this node is hovered ('21 chapters').

children.description: Authored children. Present and non-empty makes this a branch.

ordinals.description: N implicit leaves labelled "1".."N", expanded just-in-time rather than stored. Implies pick: 'range'. Mutually exclusive with `children`.

pick.description: What this node offers when focused. 'range' sweeps its ordinal children into ranges; 'set' is reserved for the deferred cross-parent basket mode; false opts out even when `ordinals` is present. Absent means navigate-only. NEVER inferred from label shapes.

block.description: While picking, shade and label ordinals in blocks of this size (default 10).

value.description: Explicit weight, overriding the derived leaf count. Drives the wedge's angle.

color.description: Slice colour override. Any CSS colour react-native-svg accepts.

group.description: Marks an organizational layer the Flatten control can hoist away, promoting its children into its place. A group must have children, or Flatten would make it vanish.

meta.description: Arbitrary author payload. Ignored by the engine and handed back with the node on select.

arrangements.description: Author-declared orderings offered alongside the automatic Canonical / A–Z / By size.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique among this node's arrangements.

depth.description: How many levels below this node to gather (1 = direct children). Lets a node offer a cross-level index, e.g. every book two levels down.

sort.description: 'label' sorts alphabetically (numeric-aware), 'value-desc' by weight descending, 'none' keeps authored order.

weighted.description: Whether this arrangement reports as proportional, which propagates weights into summary buckets.
